info.title: Verified Service Marketplace — Milestone A
info.description: Milestone A implementation: cookie sessions, organizations/staff, private profile drafts, evidence submission and revisions, administrator review, notifications, explicit public publication, and precise simulated badges. Website mutations require CSRF and relevant exact ETags. Partner OAuth and administrator MFA remain planned; no JWT login is implemented. Core service catalog and initial public discovery implemented; safe service images are implemented; booking, administrator MFA, and partner OAuth remain planned.
